critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx is 965 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting NEURAL-LINK header (with stats renderer) into a separate component such as NeuralLinkHeader.jsx, alongside the existing DraggableTab + renderTabBody extractions suggested in iteration_36.

Backend stats_summary uses count_documents per collection with per-request $bsonSize aggregation (up to 9 collections for a user) — acceptable at current scale but could add a lightweight Mongo index on user_id for each of these collections if not already present (tasks/notes/files/conversations/messages/memories/email_accounts/reminders/file_chunks) to keep this snappy under load.

In stats_summary the admin branch uses db.command({collStats: name}) which returns UNCOMPRESSED size; user branch uses $bsonSize $$ROOT which is the raw BSON size. These are two different metrics — admin's 'db_mb' therefore isn't strictly comparable to a user's. Minor semantic caveat; consider documenting or unifying (e.g. both use $bsonSize) to avoid confusion.

Sidebar addNote (L544-550) refreshes only notes list, not stats — the notes counter in NEURAL LINK header will stay stale until an external refreshKey change (or full reload). Non-blocking per review request, but worth calling loadStats() at the end of addNote for consistency.
stats.db_mb.toFixed(2) at Sidebar.jsx L800 would throw if db_mb ever came back non-numeric; safe today given backend rounds, but a `Number(stats.db_mb || 0).toFixed(2)` guard would harden it.
